params.name: startDate
params.description: Any date between 2000-01-01 and current date (format: yyyy-MM-dd).

params.name: endDate
params.description: Any date up to current date but after startDate. If left blank, only data for startDate will be returned (format: yyyy-MM-dd).

params.name: asset_ID
params.description: This parameter can contain up to 20 comma-separated Asset IDs.

params.name: pool_participant_ID
params.description: This parameter can contain up to 20 comma-separated Pool Participant IDs.

items.docs:
Fetch AIES Metered Volume for a given date or date range. 

If only the startDate is provided, data will only be provided for that day. 


Optional parameters asset_ID and pool_participant_ID can be provided to limit the data returned. The asset_ID and pool_participant_ID parameters are comma separated lists. At most, one of the two parameters can be passed in an API call.
